description: A maintainer teaches with learn: [kind scoping] that lib/sdk/ is a copied third-party SDK, so error handling findings don't apply there. Later SDK files shouldn't raise it; the same finding in src/ must still be raised.

correction.comment: @lgtmoose learn: [path lib/sdk/**] [kind scoping] lib/sdk is a copy of the vendor's SDK that we never edit; missing error handling there isn't ours to fix.
